questions.q: Tokyo Olympian C. A. Bhavani Devi is associated with which sport?
questions.solution:
C. A. Bhavani Devi is an Indian fencer; at the Tokyo Olympics she became the first Indian to compete in (and win a bout at) Olympic fencing.

**Answer: Fencing**
questions.shortcut: 'Bhavani' evokes the goddess associated with a sword — a hint toward the sword sport, fencing.

questions.q: As of 31st May 2025, who is the Chairman of the Bar Council of India?
questions.solution:
As of 31 May 2025, the Chairman of the Bar Council of India is Manan Kumar Mishra, re-elected to the post in March 2025 for a seventh consecutive term.

**Answer: Manan Kumar Mishra**

questions.q: In 2025, the Women Entrepreneurship Platform (WEP), launched EmpowHER Biz - Sapno Ki Udaan in partnership with ____.
questions.solution:
In January 2025, the Women Entrepreneurship Platform (WEP) of NITI Aayog launched 'EmpowHER Biz - Sapno Ki Udaan' in partnership with New Shop, a 24/7 convenience retail chain, to support women entrepreneurs in the retail sector.

**Answer: New Shop**

questions.q: Announced in the Union Budget 2025-26, what is the primary objective of the National Geospatial Mission?
options: To create and manage an integrated geospatial infrastructure for governance and development
To promote satellite launch services for private companies
To provide free GPS services to rural areas
To monitor climate change patterns through satellite data
questions.solution:
Announced in Union Budget 2025-26, the National Geospatial Mission aims to develop foundational geospatial infrastructure and data — an integrated framework to support planning, governance and development projects across the country.

**Answer: To create and manage an integrated geospatial infrastructure for governance and development**

questions.q: Which index in 2025 highlighted that account ownership in India has reached to 89% since 2011?
questions.solution:
The World Bank's Global Findex Database 2025 highlighted that account ownership in India has risen to 89% of adults (from about 35% in 2011), driven largely by the Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana.

**Answer: Global Findex 2025**

questions.q: Project _______ is the world's first inter-continental large wild carnivore translocation project.
questions.solution:
Project Cheetah — the reintroduction of cheetahs from Namibia and South Africa into Kuno National Park from 2022 — is described as the world's first inter-continental large wild carnivore translocation project.

**Answer: Cheetah**

questions.q: Who is the author of the book 'The Illicit Happiness of Other People'?
questions.solution:
'The Illicit Happiness of Other People' (2012) is a novel by Indian writer and journalist Manu Joseph, the author of 'Serious Men'.

**Answer: Manu Joseph**
questions.shortcut: Link the author pair: Manu Joseph — 'Serious Men' — also wrote this novel.

questions.q: 'Abhanga Vanis' are folk songs of which state?
questions.solution:
Abhangs are Marathi devotional songs of the Warkari bhakti tradition (saints such as Tukaram and Namdev), so 'Abhanga Vanis' belong to Maharashtra.

**Answer: Maharashtra**
questions.shortcut: Abhang = Marathi devotional verse of the Warkari saints → Maharashtra.

questions.q: The 'Joda' dance, performed on a full moon night around Holi, belongs to which Indian state?
questions.solution:
The Jhora (Jhoda) dance is a community folk dance of Kumaon-Garhwal in Uttarakhand, performed in circles by men and women during festivals such as Holi, traditionally on full-moon nights.

**Answer: Uttarakhand**

questions.q: If a satellite is in the plane of the equator with 0 degrees inclination and at a height of about 36000 km then it is said to be in _______ orbit.
questions.solution:
A satellite about 36,000 km above the equator, in the equatorial plane (0° inclination), has a 24-hour period and appears fixed over one point on the equator — a geostationary orbit.

**Answer: Geo-stationary**
questions.shortcut: 0° inclination + ~36,000 km height = geostationary; 90° inclination = polar orbit.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a main factor affecting the rate of evaporation?
questions.solution:
The rate of evaporation increases with surface area, temperature, wind speed and decreases with humidity. Buoyancy plays no role in evaporation, so it is NOT a main factor.

**Answer: Buoyancy**

questions.q: What is gravitational potential energy?
options: Energy possessed by an object due to its motion
Energy stored in an object due to its position above the ground
Energy that is released during a chemical reaction
questions.solution:
Gravitational potential energy is the energy an object possesses because of its position above the ground ($U = mgh$) — not due to motion (that is kinetic energy).

**Answer: Energy stored in an object due to its position above the ground**

questions.q: India's first airport based self-powered indoor air quality monitoring facility 'Pavana Chitra' was unveiled at which airport in October 2024?
questions.solution:
'Pavana Chitra', India's first airport-based self-powered indoor air-quality monitoring facility, was unveiled at Thiruvananthapuram International Airport in October 2024 during the C-DAC HIMASHIELD 2024 event.

**Answer: Thiruvananthapuram International Airport**

questions.q: Which railway zone became India's first to switch to compostable bioplastic on trains in August 2025?
questions.solution:
Northeast Frontier Railway (NFR) became India's first railway zone to switch to compostable bioplastic (bags) on trains, rolling out from 15 August 2025 across about 25 trains in collaboration with IIT Guwahati.

**Answer: Northeast Frontier Railway**

questions.q:
Which of the following Mughal Emperor was assassinated by his nobles?
I. Farrukh Siyar
II. Alamgir II
questions.solution:
Both later Mughal emperors were killed by their own nobles: Farrukh Siyar was deposed, blinded and strangled in 1719 by the faction of the Syed Brothers, and Alamgir II was assassinated in 1759 by his wazir Imad-ul-Mulk.

**Answer: Both I and II**

questions.q: In the context of Microeconomics, the graphical representation of the demand function is called the _______.
questions.solution:
In microeconomics, the graphical representation of the demand function (price on one axis, quantity demanded on the other) is called the demand curve.

**Answer: demand curve**

questions.q: The National Infrastructure Pipeline was launched in India in ___.
questions.solution:
The National Infrastructure Pipeline — a ₹111 lakh crore investment plan of infrastructure projects for FY 2020-25 — was launched in 2020 along with its task-force report.

**Answer: 2020**

questions.q: Abhijit Sen was the chairman of the Committee on the Wholesale Price Index which submitted its report in ____.
questions.solution:
The Committee on Wholesale Price Index numbers, headed by Prof. Abhijit Sen, submitted its report in 2008, recommending a new WPI series with base 2004-05.

**Answer: 2008**

questions.q: Which of the following subjects falls under the Concurrent List in the Indian Constitution?
questions.solution:
Criminal matters (criminal law and procedure) fall in the Concurrent List. Police is a State subject, while radio and television broadcasting and foreign affairs are Union subjects.

**Answer: Criminal matters**
questions.shortcut: Police = State; defence, foreign affairs, broadcasting = Union; criminal law, education, forests = Concurrent.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a cropping season in India?
questions.solution:
India has three cropping seasons — Kharif, Rabi and Zaid. 'Barani' refers to rain-fed (unirrigated) cultivation, not a cropping season.

**Answer: Barani**
questions.shortcut: Only three seasons exist: Kharif, Rabi, Zaid — any other term is not a season.

questions.q: Who among the following was the deputy chairman of Planning Commission under the tenth five year plan?
questions.solution:
K.C. Pant served as Deputy Chairman of the Planning Commission from 1999 to 2004, covering the formulation and launch of the Tenth Five Year Plan (2002-07).

**Answer: K.C. Pant**

questions.q:
In the context of trade policy tools, Which of the following is considered as non-tariff measure?

I. Anti-dumping measures

II. Technical barriers to trade measures
questions.solution:
Both are non-tariff measures: anti-dumping duties (contingent trade-protective measures) and technical barriers to trade restrict imports through means other than ordinary customs tariffs, as grouped under the UNCTAD classification of NTMs.

**Answer: Both I and II**
questions.concept: External Sector and Currency Exchange rate
questions.shortcut: Anything other than a plain customs duty (quotas, licensing, TBT, anti-dumping) is a non-tariff measure.

questions.q: What led to the decline in mortality rate in India during 1921-1951?
questions.solution:
During 1921-1951 the mortality rate in India declined mainly because of improved health and sanitation measures (control of epidemics), even though the birth rate remained high.

**Answer: Improved health and sanitation**

questions.q: What are the temporary finger-like extensions of the cell surface used by Amoeba to take in food called?
questions.solution:
Amoeba engulfs food using pseudopodia ('false feet') — temporary finger-like extensions of the cell surface that also help in movement.

**Answer: Pseudopodia**

questions.q: What does 'moksha' stand for in the fourfold objective of life according to Vedic philosophy?
questions.solution:
The fourfold objectives of life (purusharthas) are dharma, artha, kama and moksha. Moksha means liberation of the soul — spiritual freedom from the cycle of birth and death.

**Answer: Spiritual freedom**
